title: One query
eyebrow: CETI · AI and energy, by the numbers
lede: One median AI prompt is 0.24 Wh, less than a second of a microwave. Counted up, the same energy is 1.5 % of the world's electricity and 23 % of Ireland's. Small per query, large per grid: the picture depends on what you divide by.
captions: AI is using far too much energy.
AI is using almost no energy.
Both come with true numbers. Count them.
One question to a chatbot. One mark.
Google, 2025: a median text prompt takes 0.24 Wh.
A 1,000 W microwave runs 0.86 s on that.
A 60 W bulb: 14 s. A fraction of a minute.
Ask 10 a day: 2.4 Wh, 8.6 s of microwave.
Zoom out: each step is ten times the queries.
100,000 queries: 24 kWh.
100,000 queries become one tile.
A 100 MW site, 24 hours: 2.4 GWh.
100,000 tiles of 100,000 queries: 10 billion.
Now the world. One mark is one TWh.
Data centres, all kinds, 2024: 415 TWh.
Against the world's electricity: 1.5 %.
Same marks, now by region.
US about 187 TWh, China 104, Europe 62.
45 %, 25 %, 15 % of the world's data-centre power.
Now each country against its own grid.
Cut at Ireland, 2025: 7,663 GWh.
23 % of Ireland's metered electricity.
15 times the world's 1.5 %.
Cut at the US, 2023: 176 TWh.
4.4 % of its grid.
Yet about half of 2025's US demand growth.
Monday: for any AI energy figure, ask: per what?
Per query? Per site? Per grid?

brand.takeaway: Small per query, large per grid. Divided by what?

sources: Google (2025). Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google Scale; blog: Measuring the environmental impact of AI inference. cloud.google.com/blog/products/infrastructure/measuring-the-environmental-impact-of-ai-inference
IEA (2025). Energy and AI, World Energy Outlook Special Report, "Energy demand from AI". iea.org/reports/energy-and-ai/energy-demand-from-ai
IEA (2026). Electricity 2026 (executive summary, demand) and Global Energy Review 2026. iea.org/reports/electricity-2026
Shehabi et al. (2024). 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory. eta-publications.lbl.gov/publications/2024-lbnl-data-center-energy-usage-report
Central Statistics Office Ireland (2026). Data Centres Metered Electricity Consumption 2025. cso.ie/en/releasesandpublications/ep/p-dcmec/datacentresmeteredelectricityconsumption2025/keyfindings/
Ember (2025). Grids for data centres: ambitious grid planning can win Europe's AI race. ember-energy.org
EPRI (2026). Powering Intelligence: updated U.S. data center scenarios. powering-intelligence.epri.com/load-growth.html
Stated assumption of the film: a definition (1,000 W microwave, 60 W bulb, ten prompts a day, a 100 MW site at full load), not a measurement.
honest: Assumed: a 1,000 W microwave, a 60 W bulb, 10 prompts a day, a 100 MW site at full load. Per-query figures: one vendor's median text prompt (Google, 2025), not independently verified.
